name: Ashley Freeman
title: Clinical Psychologist & EMDR Therapist
description: Ashley (she/her) is a Clinical Psychologist and EMDR therapist. She works with adults and young adults aged 16+ experiencing trauma, anxiety, depression, sexual health, relationship issues, and adjustment difficulties. She draws from EMDR, CBT, ACT, DBT, and Internal Family Systems (IFS) therapy. Sees clients Tuesdays, Thursdays & Fridays.
specialties: Trauma, EMDR, Sexual health, IFS, DBT

name: Bonnie Brown
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
description: Bonnie is an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker and EMDR-trained therapist with a particular focus on complex trauma recovery, sexual assault and sexuality, family violence, and harmful sexual behaviour treatment. Her practice is informed by EMDR, TF-CBT and other evidence-based approaches. Especially passionate about supporting neurodivergent individuals.
specialties: Complex trauma, Sexual assault, Sexuality, Family violence, EMDR, TF-CBT, Children and young people, Neurodivergent

name: Caroline Burrows
title: Practice Director, Accredited Mental Health Social Worker & Psychotherapist
description: Caroline is the Practice Director and founder of Mindful Living. She has a special interest in the treatment of trauma and complex PTSD in victim/survivors of crime, having worked for many years in a sexual assault counselling service. She is a leading Accredited EMDR Trainer and Consultant in Australia. Caroline is focused on her consultancy and training work so does not have capacity to take on clients.
specialties: Complex PTSD, Trauma, Sexual assault, EMDR training and consultation

name: Edita Manak
title: Educational and Developmental Psychologist
description: Edita is an Educational and Developmental Psychologist and Accredited EMDR Practitioner who enjoys working with children, adolescents and young adults. She applies CBT, ACT, EMDR, Internal Family Systems (IFS), arts therapy, mindfulness, play therapy and family therapy, with a special interest in young people experiencing trauma, anxiety, depression, grief and bullying. Works from a neurodiversity affirming framework.
specialties: EMDR, Trauma, Children, Adolescents, IFS, Neurodiversity affirming

name: Emily Hoskin
title: Clinical Manager and Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
description: Emily is the Clinical Manager at Mindful Living. Emily is EMDR trained and has coordinated the first inpatient EMDR program in Melbourne. She has developed specialised skills in working with complex trauma, emergency service workers and providing supervision. Modalities include EMDR, ACT, Narrative Therapy and Motivational Interviewing.
specialties: Complex trauma, EMDR, Emergency service workers

name: Emma Brooks
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
description: Emma is an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker, Counsellor and EMDR-trained therapist with experience supporting children, adolescents and adults who have experienced family violence, sexual abuse and early childhood trauma, complex trauma and PTSD. Her approaches include EMDR, Internal Family Systems and Strengths-based Therapy.
specialties: Complex trauma, PTSD, Sexual abuse, Family violence, EMDR, IFS

name: Emma Rendell
title: Intake & EMDR Clinician, Accredited Mental Health Occupational Therapist
identity: Her lived experience of neurodivergence, chronic pain, and rural living
description: Emma warmly welcomes LGBTQIA+, First Nations, culturally and linguistically diverse, and neurodivergent folk into her therapy space. She supports people navigating anxiety, depression, trauma, identity exploration, neurodivergence and grief, blending EMDR, parts work, spirituality, sensory modulation and narrative therapy. Currently co-facilitates EMDR Group Programs and doesn't have capacity for new clients.
specialties: EMDR, Trauma, LGBTQIA+, Parts work, Neurodivergence, Endometriosis/PMDD

name: Heidi Chia
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
description: Heidi is an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker and EMDR-trained therapist working with older children, adolescents and adults, with a focus on relational trauma and complex PTSD. She draws on EMDR, ACT, CBT, Child-Parent Psychotherapy, and integrates mindfulness and somatic approaches. Sees clients Mondays and Thursdays.
specialties: Complex PTSD, Relational trauma, EMDR, Adolescents

name: Jessica Gardner
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker and Family Therapist
description: Jess is an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker, Family Therapist and Accredited EMDR Practitioner who works with clients of all ages. Jess has a special interest in trauma and draws on systemic and integrative frameworks, using EMDR, family therapy, single session framework and solution-focused therapy. Offers therapy online part time.

name: Joel Taylor
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
description: Joel is an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker and Accredited EMDR Clinician with a special interest in working with adolescents, grief and loss, and those impacted by complex trauma. Joel also enjoys working with the LGBTIQ+ community. He draws on EMDR, ACT, solution-focused and narrative therapy, and is trained in the Neurosequential Model of Therapeutics.
specialties: Complex trauma, EMDR, LGBTIQ+, Adolescents, Grief and loss
